react_native_issues.issue: Google Maps JS console warning: 'As of February 21st, 2024, google.maps.Marker is deprecated. Please use google.maps.marker.AdvancedMarkerElement instead.' Not scheduled for discontinuation, non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LiveMap.tsx:43-45. Optional migration to AdvancedMarkerElement (requires mapId).

Console advisory: 'Google Maps JavaScript API has been loaded directly without loading=async.' Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LiveMap.tsx:51 — script tag already has async attribute but Google recommends passing loading=async in the query string as well.
Console still emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. No user impact.

critical_code_review_comments: LiveMap.tsx:66-77 — Platform.OS==='web' branch correctly renders <iframe data-testid='live-map' srcDoc={html}> via React.createElement so the same testID is exposed on web. Native branch continues to use react-native-webview's WebView. Fix is clean and minimal.

MapPlaceholder.tsx:30,58-60 — chip now derives text from `mapsConfigured = !!process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY`. When the key is set the chip reads 'Live map' with the map-outline icon; when unset it falls back to 'Maps: not configured' with the warning icon. Correct behaviour verified on Home 'Active Delivery' preview.
LiveMap srcdoc uses gm_authFailure fallback and disables default UI + enables greedy gesture handling — good UX for embedded map in a scroll view.

iframe height is hard-coded to 260px on web while the outer wrap has minHeight 240px + track screen passes minHeight 240 — consider making the web iframe height derive from the surrounding style to stay parity with native. Non-blocking.
